svg.title: Petar Majić: Education, Experience and Engineering Tools
svg.desc: Education. University of Zagreb, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing. MSc in Computing, Computer Science track, October 2025 – July 2027 (expected); relevant coursework: Machine Learning, Deep Learning. BSc in Computing, October 2021 – July 2025; bachelor’s thesis: facial expression classification; deep learning: CNN, Keras, TensorFlow. Université de Tours, Polytech Tours: Erasmus+ exchange semester, September 2025 – January 2026; computer vision: instance segmentation, YOLO11, OpenCV; natural language processing: TF-IDF, SVM, BERT, scikit-learn; data and evaluation: dataset preparation, cross-validation, model comparison. Experience. Abysalto: Student AI/ML Engineer, January 2026 – present; production support chatbot and supplier catalog imports; the chatbot handled nearly 30,000 production sessions; agentic AI: LangGraph, ReAct, tool calling, LLMs; document retrieval: RAG, chunking, embeddings, FAISS, pgvector; backend and data: Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis, Django; evaluation and tracing: Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry, prompt evaluation. AI Engineering Intern, Abysalto AI Academy, July – September 2025; Agent Studio: agent configuration and document search; agent integration: LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, MCP; API development: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, pytest. Shared engineering tools. Delivery and collaboration: Git, Gerrit, Azure DevOps, Jenkins. Runtime and deployment: Docker, OpenShift. Other programming experience: Java, C++.
